paraphrase: Whoever bears an occurring thought episode opines that episode's content: ∀ b e, Occurs e → Bears b e → Opines b (content e). An open bridge from the Cogito bearer vocabulary to the opining vocabulary of STMT-OPINION-IS-A-MOTION. It holds only if every bearer of an occurring episode opines the content assigned to it; a borne episode whose bearer opines nothing (for example a willing that is no opining) falsifies it.
